notes:
Default v3.1.397 / firmware rev27v-followup-355 applies the existing per-profile
pressure ceiling throughout protocol execution, including ordinary remote
primitives and pre-actuation state entry. A run freezes its ceiling across
phases, cycles and breaks; STOP, RESET, faults and completion release it.
Calibration/SysID diagnostics retain absolute250mmHg independently of a stale
preset. Open-loop inflation is bounded to120 seconds for protocols and180 seconds
for diagnostics, matching the existing SysID host allowance. Other thresholds,
gains, valve limits, calibration, SysID and PVR selection remain unchanged.
Firmware version and release date advance together. Universal lock stays disabled.

Production guard/deadline/lifetime boundaries, compatibility, protected C flash
and the fixed-seed ten-minute large-cuff soak are retained in the maintainer
evidence. Physical-fault and independent operating qualification remain separate.
The operator package contains compiled code, operator help and reviewed profiles;
project/firmware source, pinouts and build tools remain excluded.

Flash preflight waits for complete CRC-verified telemetry through torn boot text;
verified unsafe telemetry still aborts immediately. Five focused gate checks pass.
Seed213 completion stays2/4 with100%delivery each; the large-cuff operating limitation
remains accepted and is not relabeled as a nominal pass.

Custom GUI plans declare their highest fill pressure before arming the run ceiling,
including existing HOLD+5 headroom. Individual phase targets remain unchanged.
Invalid or above250 plans are refused and annotated before actuation. Built-ins
retain verified firmware START, and diagnostic context remains independent.
